producer.nose: Spring flowers, ripe gooseberry and grapefruit zest, with pineapple, white peach and a mineral undertone.
producer.palate: Fresh and fairly full; almond, white peach and citrus minerality, zesty acidity balanced by roundness, melon and apple fruit.
producer.finish: Taut acidity, faint honey, lemony mineral aftertaste of medium length with a late pithy bitterness.
producer.summary: 100% Sauvignon Blanc from Kimmeridgian limestone soils in the Upper Loire.

critics.nose: White peach and soft gooseberry with lime, pretzel and flint hints.
critics.palate: Light-plus body, smooth; ginger, gooseberry, honeydew melon, stony minerality, with green tea and white peach.
critics.summary: Rated Very Good+ (92) for the 2019 vintage.
